question: What tariffs did the US announce on 'Liberation Day' in April 2025?
text:
On **April 2, 2025**, which President Donald Trump called “Liberation Day,” the U.S. announced two tiers of new tariffs: ([whitehouse.gov](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/04/regulating-imports-with-a-reciprocal-tariff-to-rectify-trade-practices-that-contribute-to-large-and-persistent-annual-united-states-goods-trade-deficits/?utm_source=openai))

- **A 10% baseline tariff** on most U.S. goods imports, effective **April 5, 2025**. ([whitehouse.gov](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/04/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-declares-national-emergency-to-increase-our-competitive-edge-protect-our-sovereignty-and-strengthen-our-national-and-economic-security/?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=openai))
- **Higher “reciprocal” tariffs** for dozens of trading partners, scheduled to start **April 9, 2025**. These rates **replaced** the 10% baseline for covered goods from those partners; they weren’t added on top of it. ([whitehouse.gov](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/04/regulating-imports-with-a-reciprocal-tariff-to-rectify-trade-practices-that-contribute-to-large-and-persistent-annual-united-states-goods-trade-deficits/?utm_source=openai))

| Trading partner | Rate announced April 2 |
|---|---:|
| European Union | 20% |
| Japan | 24% |
| South Korea | 25% |
| India | 26% |
| Taiwan | 32% |
| China | 34% |
| Vietnam | 46% |
| Cambodia | 49% |
| Lesotho | 50% |

The full list is in Annex I of the executive order. China’s **34%** was the newly announced tariff, not its total tariff burden. ([whitehouse.gov](https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/eo-14257.pdf))

**Canada and Mexico** stayed under separate tariff rules. The new tariffs also excluded some products, including pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and certain energy products, as well as steel, aluminum, autos, and auto parts already covered by separate tariffs. The rates above are what was **announced on April 2**; many were changed or paused shortly afterward. ([whitehouse.gov](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/04/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-declares-national-emergency-to-increase-our-competitive-edge-protect-our-sovereignty-and-strengthen-our-national-and-economic-security/?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=openai))
